verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since some ship triggers, scripted workflows or agent features, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Alacritty can schedule or run autonomous background automations. The only control surface documented is the `alacritty msg` IPC (e.g. `create-window`), which an external script must drive by hand; that is not the product running automations itself.
